name: グループの招待コードカード
prompt:
Correct the attached v001 invitation card to match the native 390 × 394 px preview exactly. Use the native preview as ground truth, and use v001 only as the image to correct. The v001 card is too wide and shifted left, and the QR pattern was changed.

Set the white card to x=30,y=40,w=330,h=338 with a thin #E8ECE9 border and 12 px rounded corners. Center the 50×50 mint avatar at x=170,y=12 so it overlaps the top card edge; keep 「光」 centered in Meiryo Bold 14 px #064E3B. Keep the title 「地域のなかま」 centered at x=46,y=82,w=298,h=28 in Meiryo Bold 20 px #1D1D1D, and caption 「グループの招待コード・見本」 centered at x=46,y=118,w=298,h=16 in Meiryo Regular 12 px #6E6E6E.

Replace the altered QR in v001 with the exact original sample shown in both attached QR references, at x=108,y=162,w=174,h=174. Preserve the black-and-white module pattern, the three corner markers, and central WhatsApp logo exactly. Do not generate a different QR. The QR is a retained sample image and is not an operational invite.

There is no visible hyperlink text in this component. Keep the title dark and caption gray, without underline. If any real hyperlink text appears, color only that text blue #1976D2. Do not add a URL, link label, copy button, English text, portrait, or decoration.
reviewNotes: v002 restores the exact 174x174 native QR crop at its native position; QR patch pixel difference is zero. Remaining residual: card is about 4px too wide per side and bottom border about 9px too high. Two attempts complete, so retain needs-correction. No visible hyperlink text.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
